mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 8.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0, the manufacturing sector slowdown signals an impending economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO is below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a dual shock to supply and labor markets, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both INDPRO and UNRATE decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
